purpose: Additive post-result normal-relaxation question; no frozen set is replaced

questions.query: What does the active-normal copied-value candidate change, and do stopped COM targets prove live Sand clearance or allow unused support capacity to be borrowed?
facts: Only normal relaxation over approaching/loaded contacts changes; original capacity shares, four passes and tangent/energy rules stay fixed.
Nine synthetic COM targets stop, but a capped front keeps its original capacity and residual speed.
Value results do not qualify live World/Rapier, original SOL authority or default promotion; tangent computational energy can increase.
